fk_hinweis: Drag the points or change the values in the table. Arrow keys move the selected point.
fk_vorgabeGilt: No own points – the default applies. Dragging a point or “+” takes it over as a starting value.
fk_zurVorgabe: Use the default again (delete own points)
fk_fZuWenig: At least two points are needed.
fk_fBereich: Point %s: the power must be between 0 and 100 %.
fk_fAufsteigend: The temperatures must rise from row to row.
fk_fFallend: The heating curve must fall: the colder outside, the more power.
fk_fSteigend: The cooling curve must rise: the warmer outside, the more power.
fk_fGrenzen: The lower limit must be at least 30 % and not above the upper limit; the upper limit at most 100 %.
